notes.title: Devlog - Caaaaats!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

In the last few weeks, I’ve made a lot of progress on Solace Creek. I’d estimate that around half of the game is finished. Since the first level, I’ve added two more large areas and also gone back to refine the first level with more assets and details. Some of those updates are already available in the current demo version.

[h2]Finding the Heart of Solace Creek[/h2]
I’m also getting closer to the atmosphere I want the game to have. When I start a game project, I have ideas, references, a vision—but a lot of what makes a game work only comes together while building it for me. The atmosphere, the pacing, the way different elements interact—these things reveal themselves in the process. Solace Creek has always been a horror game, but the more I work on it, the more I realize that mystery plays an equally big role. And sometimes, even a moment of levity can make the eerie parts hit harder. A good example is this small companion you can come across:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OSXoVWIxPDM


[h2]Finding the Sound of Solace Creek[/h2]
I’ve also been working a lot on the music. Not only on the overall vibe I want to go for, but also how to incorporate it in the game. The soundtrack has to build tension without always being in the foreground, which makes it a challenge, but I think I’m finding the right balance. I recently finished a track for a new area that I really like. It also includes a small homage to one of the inspirations behind the game:
[url=https://soundcloud.com/dustb0/echoes-solace-creek-ost]https://soundcloud.com/dustb0/echoes-solace-creek-ost[/url]

[h2]Thanks everyone 💕[/h2]
A huge thank you to everyone who has been following and supporting Solace Creek! Seeing your feedback and excitement keeps me motivated, and I really appreciate every share, comment, and message. If you enjoyed the demo, spreading the word helps more than you know. More updates coming soon—I can’t wait to show you what’s next!

notes.title: Demo 0.4.5 Release - Updated Cutscenes & Polish Version
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to announce the release of version 0.4.5 of the demo! This update brings several enhancements that will also be part of the full game, including polished cutscenes and a new Polish language option.

[h2]Improved Cutscenes[/h2]
I've refined various cutscenes to enhance the overall experience. Most of these small adjustments are more detailed character animations or more shots to enhance the atmosphere. Here's a small teaser from the intro ☺️
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GqG0YNP.png[/img]

[h2]Polish Version[/h2]
The Solace Creek demo is now available in Polish, thanks to the outstanding work of KapTom! You can change the language anytime through the game's options menu. More languages will be coming soon, so stay tuned!

As always, thank you so much for your continued support and enthusiasm. It means the world to me to see how many of you are excited about Solace Creek and how the game is shaping up!

notes.title: Demo 0.4.4 Release - Inventory System & Italian Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to announce the release of version 0.4.4 of the demo! This update introduces several new features that will also be part of the full game, including a new game menu that houses the inventory and current objective.

[h2]Inventory & Current Objective[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qaJyxLt.png[img][url=][/url][/img][/img]
The "Current Objective" feature helps keep you on track, providing a quick reminder of your current goal. The inventory is not just for storing items - in the full version you will also be able to use items from here or select specific items to solve riddles.

[h2]Italian Version[/h2]
Additionally, the Solace Creek demo is now available in Italian, thanks to the outstanding work of Alberto Brusegan! You can change the language anytime through the game's options menu. More languages will be coming soon, so stay tuned!


[h2]Improved Cutscenes[/h2]
I've also made some adjustments to a few cutscenes, including new animations for the main character. You can check out an example here: [url=https://x.com/Dustb0/status/1841583969579507877]https://x.com/Dustb0/status/1841583969579507877[/url]

As always, thank you so much for your continued support and enthusiasm. It means the world to me to see how many of you are excited about Solace Creek and how the game is shaping up!

notes.title: Demo 0.4.2 Release - macOS Support & Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for the amazing feedback on the demo over the past week! It’s been incredibly motivating ✨. I’ve watched many of your Let's Plays, read through your comments, and gathered your feedback to make some improvements, which are included in this latest update. I wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude for all your support!

Here are some of the improvements in this update:
[list]
[*]Enhanced controller support across all menus
[*]Fixed an issue where certain sounds were louder than the volume settings
[*]A macOS version is now available 🍏
[/list]

Thanks again, and see you soon!
